summary: Build practical gender governance, budgeting, measurement, and reporting skills across five days. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Gender governance links gender equality commitments to organizational decisions, budgets, accountability, and evidence. This training is for gender equality advisors, HR leaders, sustainability managers, and public policy professionals who need to put commitments into practice. It covers intersectional gender analysis, gender-responsive budget reviews, and selecting indicators to report progress through dashboards and implementation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate, govern, measure, or report gender equality commitments across public, private, nonprofit, development, and multilateral operating contexts.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of organizational policy, programme management, human resources, sustainability, public administration, compliance, or related governance work. Prior exposure to gender equality concepts is recommended. No programming is required. You should bring access to representative, anonymized organizational examples where permitted. Advanced topics such as intersectional analysis, AI-assisted evidence review, and digital dashboards are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
